lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is Tuesday's Town Council meeting, where the gondola replacement project takes a concrete step forward — Council votes on the Fourth Supplement to the Gondola IGA, locking in cost-sharing for the 2027 planning and development budget, and two ordinances get first readings, including one touching the Telluride Energy Mitigation Program. On the same day, Ouray County commissioners are deep in a work session on a proposed EMS and Ridgway Fire merger, a structural decision with real consequences for emergency response across the region. The Gondola Advisory Committee and SMART both meet Monday to hear where federal FTA funding pursuit actually stands.

notable.stake: Council votes on gondola cost-sharing IGA and reads two new ordinances.
Federal funding pipeline update for gondola replacement — public comment opportunity.
FTA Capital Investment Program update reveals gondola project's federal funding status.
Ouray BOCC votes on a fifth extension of an active Emergency Disaster Declaration.
Proposed EMS and Ridgway Fire merger discussed — shapes staffing and response times.
